info.title: Simplepod.ai API
info.description: # REST API ## Overview The API is based on REST principles. It supports GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE requests. ## 📢 Join Our Community on Discord We’ve set up a dedicated Discord channel for developers working with our API. It’s the best place to: - Ask questions and get support from the team - Share feedback and feature requests - Connect with other developers building on the API 👉 [Click here to join the Discord channel](https://dash.simplepod.ai/discord) ## Base URI All URLs referenced in the documentation have the following base: https:\/\/api\.simplepod\.ai ## Postman Collection You can fork postman collection to your workspace and test the API via this link: [](https://www.postman.com/simplepod/simplepod-ai/collection/lun16qv/simplepod-ai-api) ## Authentication ## Port Mapping When you rent a Docker instance, each exposed port receives two types of connections: - **Direct** — connect to the host IP and mapped port directly - **Proxy** — connect through a Cloudflare tunnel URL (HTTPS) Port mappings are returned in the `ports` field of instance API responses (`GET /instances/{id}`, `GET /instances/list`). ### Container file Inside the running container, port mappings are stored at: ``` /etc/simplepod/mapPortCfUser.json ``` Example contents: ```json { "20000": { "protocol": "http", "proxyProtocol": "https", "proxyUrl": "https://example.trycloudflare.com", "service": "console" } } ``` Each key is the internal port number. Fields: - `protocol` — the protocol used for direct connections - `proxyProtocol` — the protocol used for proxied connections - `proxyUrl` — the full Cloudflare tunnel URL for this port - `service` — the service name (e.g. `console`, `ssh`, `jupyter`)

apiKey.name: X-AUTH-TOKEN
apiKey.description:
To call api methods you must provide api key.
The api key is listed in Account Settings on Subaccouts tab.
Each api key is assigned to subaccount and its permissions.

post.description: Creates a new private Docker image template group. Allows specifying a custom Docker image with optional private registry authentication (host, username, password), disk size allocation, exposed ports, start script, ARG options, ENV variables, and feature toggles (SSH server, Jupyter). The template is private to the authenticated user and can be used when renting Docker instances.

post.description: Creates a new Docker rental instance on the selected host. Validates balance and availability. Supports batch creation via `numOfInstances`.

instanceMarket.description: IRI of instance market. Obtain from GET /instances/market/list?mode=docker&rentalStatus=active

x-codeSamples.label: CLI
x-codeSamples.source:
curl --location --request POST 'https://api.simplepod.ai/instances' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'X-AUTH-TOKEN: apiKey' \
--data-raw '{
   "gpuCount": 1,
   "instanceMarket": "/instances/market/1",
   "instanceTemplate": "/instances/templates/38"
}'

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

$apiKey = ''; // Replace with your API key

// 1. We must obtain the list of available VM rental instances to provide instanceMarket
curl_setopt_array($curl, [
    CURLOPT_URL => 'https://api.simplepod.ai/instances/market/list?mode=vm&rentalStatus=active',
    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
    CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
    CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
    CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
    CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
    CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
    CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ["X-AUTH-TOKEN: {$apiKey}"],
]);

$response = curl_exec($curl);

$instanceMarketId = json_decode($response, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)[0]['id'] ?? null;
$instanceTemplateId = 29; // Replace with a valid instance template ID

if (null === $instanceMarketId) {
    throw new RuntimeException('No available VM rental instances found.');
}

$data = [
    'instanceMarket' => "/instances/market/{$instanceMarketId}",
    'instanceTemplate' => "/instances/templates/{$instanceTemplateId}",
    'envVariables' => [['name' => 'ENV1', 'value' => 'VALUE1']],
];

try {
    curl_setopt_array($curl, [
        CURLOPT_URL => 'https://api.simplepod.ai/instances',
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
        CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
        CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
        CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => json_encode($data, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ["X-AUTH-TOKEN: {$apiKey}"],
    ]);
} catch (JsonException $e) {
}

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

post.description:
Creates a new VPS rental instance. Validates balance and availability before proceeding.

**Linux-based images:** Provide `userSshKey` with an IRI of a saved SSH key or a raw public SSH key. If a raw key is provided, it is saved automatically. Optionally set `userSshKeyName` to name the saved key.

**Windows-based images:** Provide `password` instead of an SSH key.

instanceMarket.description: IRI of instance market. Obtain from GET /instances/market/list?mode=vm&rentalStatus=active

userSshKey.description: IRI of user SSH key or raw public SSH key (required for Linux images)

userSshKeyName.description: Name to save for the public SSH key (optional, used with Linux images)

password.description: Password for the VPS instance (required for Windows images)

x-codeSamples.label: CLI
x-codeSamples.source:
curl --location --request POST 'https://api.simplepod.ai/instances' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'X-AUTH-TOKEN: apiKey' \
--data-raw '{
   "gpuCount": 1,
   "instanceMarket": "/instances/market/1",
   "instanceVmImage": "/instances/images/29"
}'

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

$apiKey = ''; // Replace with your API key

// 1. We must obtain the list of available VM rental instances to provide instanceMarket
curl_setopt_array($curl, [
    CURLOPT_URL => 'https://api.simplepod.ai/instances/market/list?mode=vm&rentalStatus=active',
    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
    CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
    CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
    CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
    CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
    CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
    CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ["X-AUTH-TOKEN: {$apiKey}"],
]);

$response = curl_exec($curl);

$instanceMarketId = json_decode($response, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)[0]['id'] ?? null;
$instanceImageId = 29; // Replace with a valid instance image ID
$userSshKeyId = 5; // Replace with a valid user SSH key ID

if (null === $instanceMarketId) {
    throw new RuntimeException('No available VM rental instances found.');
}

// 2. Now we can create a new VM rental instance
$data = [
    'instanceMarket' => "/instances/market/{$instanceMarketId}",
    'instanceVmImage' => "/instances/images/{$instanceImageId}",
    'userSshKey' => "/user-ssh-keys/{$userSshKeyId}",
];

try {
    curl_setopt_array($curl, [
        CURLOPT_URL => 'https://api.simplepod.ai/instances',
        CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
        CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
        CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
        CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
        CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
        CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
        CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
        CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => json_encode($data, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),
        CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ["X-AUTH-TOKEN: {$apiKey}"],
    ]);
} catch (JsonException $e) {
}

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

post.description: Resumes a previously paused VPS instance on a new host. The instance retains its configuration, SSH key, and IP address. Can be referenced by instance IRI or support ID (e.g., 'V_abcd'). Validates balance and host availability before proceeding.

instanceMarket.description: IRI of instance market. Obtain from GET /instances/market/list?mode=vm&rentalStatus=active

instance.description: IRI of paused instance or support ID

    CURLOPT_URL => 'https://api.simplepod.ai/instances/market/list?mode=vm&rentalStatus=active',
    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
